The Base Cherngtalay

Condominium in Cherng Talay (Choeng Thale), Thalang
HomePhuket PropertyCondos for SaleThe Base Cherngtalay

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

The Base Cherngtalay is a low-rise condominium by Sansiri in Cherng Talay, Phuket, on a site of about 4 rai. It comprises two 8-storey buildings with 341 one- and two-bedroom apartments of roughly 27 to 63 sqm. Units are sold furnished, and the project offers a pool, fitness center, co-working lounge, co-kitchen, organic farm and onsen.
